title: Star Formation and the Interstellar Medium in z > 6 UV-luminous Lyman-break Galaxies
question: What are the [C II] and FIR dust properties (SFR, [CII]/FIR ratio, dynamics) of two UV-luminous z>6 LBGs, and what do systemic redshifts from [C II] imply for Lyα velocity shifts at z~6?

what.value: Lyα spectra of CLM 1 and WMH 5

evidence.quote: Optical spectroscopy, including the detection of asymmetric Ly$\alpha$ emission lines and continuum breaks, of both galaxies were presented in their discovery papers

what.value: Lyα velocity shifts of A383-5.2 and GN-108036

evidence.quote: The first measurement of Ly$\alpha$ velocity shifts at redshifts relevant to the reionization epoch have recently been made by (cite: Stark:2014a).
we show for comparison a sample selected at lower redshift ($2<z<3.1$) as LAEs and LBGs (cite: Erb:2014)

recipe.goal: Image and extract [C II] line and continuum
recipe.method: Re-image calibrated data with Briggs weighting, make cubes, subtract continuum in image plane, Gaussian fit spectra and maps
Greybody from 1.2 mm continuum; SFR from L_FIR and L_[CII] calibrations
assumptions: Td=30 K, beta=1.6; no CMB correction

recipe.method: CIGALE fit to UV-optical-IR plus ALMA continuum filter; NIR/IRAC photometry via GALFIT and PyGFIT
assumptions: Bruzual & Charlot SSP, constant SFR, Chabrier IMF, Z=0.008, Calzetti attenuation, Dale 2014 IR templates

recipe.goal: Lyα velocity shifts from systemic [C II]
recipe.method: Convert spectra to LSR, compare Lyα centroid to [C II] redshift, compare with literature vs equivalent width

evidence.quote: we determine the systemic redshift of the galaxy as $z=6.1657 \pm 0.0003$
The Gaussian FWHM is $162 \pm 23$ km s$^{-1}$.
For CLM 1 the measured offset is $+430 \pm 69$ km s$^{-1}$
then the offset is $+265 \pm 52$ km s$^{-1}$
this lensing configuration provides a magnification factor of only 1.13

not_stated_but_needed: line-free channels and channel ranges used for continuum subtraction
image size and cell size, clean threshold/masks
CIGALE parameter grids and fitting details
dynamical mass formula and size/inclination assumptions
how the 42.5-122.5 micron greybody integration was done
score_reason: Simple data and clear table of results, but imaging details, versions and SED fit configuration missing.
rediscovery_reason: Cycle 2 data likely public, key results (line fluxes, redshifts, continuum) are numeric and recipe mostly sufficient.
